(1) the quark-diagrams are a useful tool to analyze charm decay; (2) the data of D0→K−K+ and D0→π+π− are consistent with the W-exchange diagram and the W-annhilation diagram, respectively;
the data of charm decays can be accommodated by the quark diagram scheme, which includes the contributions of W-loop, W-exchange and W-annihilation.

the data of charm decays are best described when the W-annihlation diagram is included, the W-annhilation contribution in D→VP decay is comparable to the spectator diagram, and the W-exchange diagram is important in D→PP decay

the study of the quark-diagrams of charm decay.

the quark-diagrams of the Cabibbo-favored D decays are not the only ones contributing to the decays, but the W-annihilating and W-exchanging diagrams also play an important role.
the quark-diagrams are the most successful scheme to date for analyzing charm decays.

the W-loop diagram is not important in charm decays and the W-annihiliation diagram is important in D→VP and D→PP.
